RIDE Hack '26 Call for Startup Ideas & Aspiring Entrepreneurs

Have an innovative idea that you want to transform into a real startup? RIDE Hack’26 invites aspiring entrepreneurs, student innovators, researchers, developers, and early-stage startup teams to present their ideas and explore the opportunity to build and incubate their ventures under RIDE – Research, Innovation, Development & Entrepreneurship.

 
About RIDE:

RIDE is the incubation center at JIIT, Noida, focused on nurturing innovative ideas, supporting entrepreneurs, and helping transform promising concepts into impactful and scalable startups.

Who Can Apply?

  • Students with an innovative startup idea
  • Aspiring entrepreneurs who want to start a venture
  • Innovators and researchers looking to commercialize their ideas
  • Early-stage startups seeking incubation and mentorship
  • Individuals or teams with technology-driven solutions to real-world problems

What We Are Looking For

  • Innovative and original startup ideas
  • Technology-enabled solutions to real-world problems
  • Scalable and sustainable business ideas
  • Strong potential for social or economic impact

What You Can Get:

  • Funding Pool of ₹1 CRORE
  • Opportunity for incubation under RIDE
  • Mentorship and guidance from experts
  • Support in developing your idea into a startup
  • Access to the innovation and entrepreneurial ecosystem
  • Opportunities for networking with industry experts, investors and startup leaders
  • Guidance on business model, product development and market validation
  • Potential funding/investment opportunities for selected ventures

Important Dates:

  • Application Opens: 14 September 2026
  • Last Date to Apply: 05 October 2026
  • Shortlisting: 15 October 2026
  • Final Presentation/Pitch: 01 November 2026

Venue: Jaypee Institute of Information Technology (JIIT), Wish Town Campus, Sector 128, Noida, UP, India

For More Details Visit https://www.innovationjiit.in/
Call :  7210000082
